approved.en: Russia continues missile and sabotage attacks inside Ukraine, including a ballistic strike on Kyiv that killed one civilian and injured fourteen, and a fire near a weapons factory blamed on a Russia-run network. Ukrainian forces are conducting deep-strike missions up to 2,500 km, hitting a missile-battery plant in Yelets and a chemical plant in Voronezh, and are evacuating wounded soldiers by drone. A US-brokered ceasefire is now in effect in the occupied city of Oleshky, where residents previously survived on weeds. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Russland fortsetter missil- og sabotasjeangrep inne i Ukraina, inkludert et ballistisk angrep på Kyiv som drepte én sivil og såret fjorten, og en brann nær en våpenfabrikk som ble skylt på et Russland-styrt nettverk. Ukrainske styrker gjennomfører dype angrep på opptil 2 500 km, og treffer et missilbatterifabrikk i Yelets og et kjemisk anlegg i Voronezh, og evakuerer sårede soldater med drone. En amerikansk meklet våpenhvile er nå i kraft i den okkuperte byen Oleshky, hvor innbyggerne tidligere overlevde på ugress. Konflikten forårsaket 75 767 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Israeli forces have intensified a crackdown in Hebron, displacing thousands and prompting UN warnings of ethnic cleansing, while IDF airstrikes in Gaza have killed a child and targeted two Hamas commanders and other terror operatives linked to financing. Hamas reported the killing of two of its security operatives during a mission in Gaza. A UN panel has accused Israel of extermination in the West Bank and genocide in Gaza, and a UN inquiry found Israel continued genocide in Gaza after a ceasefire. Iran hosted regional powers for talks aimed at preventing fresh escalation, and 21,440 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

Hamas rapporterte at to av deres sikkerhetsoperatører ble drept under en operasjon i Gaza. Et FN-panel har anklaget Israel for utryddelse på Vestbredden og folkemord i Gaza, og en FN-undersøkelse fant at Israel fortsatte folkemord i Gaza etter en våpenhvile. Iran var vert for regionale makter i samtaler som hadde som mål å hindre ny opptrapping, og 21 440 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Hezbollah explosives seized from two Lebanese trucks have led Lebanon's prime minister and security forces to promise a thorough investigation while Israeli artillery and air strikes continue against Hezbollah positions in southern Lebanon, causing civilian casualties. In northern Israel a Hezbollah submunition exploded in a teenager's backpack, killing Elazar Yair Wilensky and wounding dozens, prompting an IDF probe and possible hike restrictions. Qatar has pledged funding for reconstruction in southern Lebanon, announced a massive solar plant project, and its foreign minister called for Israeli withdrawal from Lebanon. The UCDP recorded 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

I Nord-Israel eksploderte en Hezbollah-submunisjon i en tenårings ryggsekk, og drepte Elazar Yair Wilensky og såret dusinvis, noe som har ført til en IDF-undersøkelse og mulige restriksjoner på høyde. Qatar har lovet finansiering til gjenoppbygging i Sør-Libanon, kunngjort et massivt solkraftprosjekt, og utenriksministeren oppfordret til israelsk tilbaketrekning fra Libanon. approved.en: Iran is intensifying a nationwide self-sacrifice campaign and threatening diplomats while Houthi missiles and drones continue striking Saudi oil facilities and airports, prompting the reopening of Riyadh Airport after weeks of disruption. Egypt has authorised military aid for Saudi Arabia as the Houthi attacks increase, and delegations from Mecca defence pact states are meeting in Tehran to defuse Iran-US and Yemen tensions. Saudi, Turkish and Pakistani officials are preparing for talks with Iran amid the Houthi attacks, while Israel's election delays formation of a new government and fuels internal political pressure on the military. 123 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Iran intensiverer en landsomfattende selvoppofrelseskampanje og truer diplomater mens houthi-missiler og droner fortsetter å treffe saudiske oljefasiliteter og flyplasser, noe som fører til at Riyadh-flyplassen åpnes igjen etter flere ukers forstyrrelser. Egypt har godkjent militærhjelp til Saudi-Arabia ettersom houthi-angrepene øker, og delegasjoner fra Mekka-forsvarspaktens stater møtes i Teheran for å dempe spenningene mellom Iran-USA og Jemen. Saudiske, tyrkiske og pakistanske tjenestemenn forbereder samtaler med Iran midt i houthi-angrepene, mens Israels valg forsinker dannelsen av en ny regjering og øker det interne politiske presset på militæret. 123 kamprelaterte dødsfall har skjedd i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: The Houthis have intensified attacks on Saudi Arabia, striking the Ras Tanura oil refinery, oil pumping stations and Riyadh airport, while Saudi air defenses have intercepted missiles and drones. In response, the Saudi-led coalition has destroyed Houthi missile facilities and launch sites in Yemen. Iran, Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan have agreed to hold additional talks on the conflict, and Egypt's parliament has authorized military aid to Saudi Arabia. The conflict caused 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Som svar har den Saudi-ledede koalisjonen ødelagt houthienes missilanlegg og oppskytingssteder i Jemen. Iran, Saudi-Arabia, Tyrkia og Pakistan har blitt enige om å holde ytterligere samtaler om konflikten, og Egypts parlament har godkjent militærhjelp til Saudi-Arabia. Konflikten forårsaket 918 drepte i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Jordan has launched airstrikes in Syria targeting militant hideouts it says were linked to a recent church attack that killed nine people, and the strikes have also hit civilian areas, prompting Syrian condemnation of a breach of airspace. Jordan says the attacks were aimed at Islamic State elements, while families of victims deny any connection to the church attack. The Syrian government reports civilian casualties from the Jordanian strikes. The conflict continues with multiple armed groups operating in southern Syria after the fall of the Assad regime. 2,732 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Iraqi courts have sentenced six French nationals to life imprisonment and a seventh to 15 years for Islamic State membership, while a separate court sentenced seven French citizens to lengthy terms for the same crime. Security forces have repeatedly intercepted unidentified drones near Baghdad's Green Zone, with multiple reports confirming the incidents. PKK-linked Yazidi militia units are disarming and joining the Iraqi army, and three militia groups have pledged to disarm by June 2027. Iran’s rhetoric has intensified, warning the United States over its stance, and the United States has warned Baghdad it will strike Iraqi militias that join Iran’s war. The conflict produced 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Sikkerhetsstyrker har gjentatte ganger avskåret uidentifiserte droner i nærheten av Bagdads grønne sone, og flere rapporter bekrefter hendelsene. PKK-tilknyttede yazidimilitære enheter avvæpner seg og slutter seg til den irakiske hæren, og tre militsgrupper har lovet å avvæpne seg innen juni 2027. Irans retorikk har blitt skarpere, og den advarer USA om deres holdning, mens USA har advart Bagdad om at de vil slå mot irakiske militsgrupper som slutter seg til Irans krig. Konflikten førte til 396 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

Women under siege are increasingly serving as frontline responders while peace talks aim to end the drone war that fuels the humanitarian crisis. Hundreds of thousands of Sudanese refugees are now hosted in Chad as the regional humanitarian emergency expands. The conflict caused 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Coordinated cattle raids in Warrup state killed at least 72 people, and a drone strike on a market in the disputed Abyei region killed at least 73. President Kiir reshuffled the South Sudan Revenue Authority board, reinstating two commissioners after cancelling a previous order, while the Bar Association launched a roadmap to improve access to justice. The government partnered with Israel's Gilat to provide nationwide satellite internet and secured UNESCO world-heritage nomination for the Boma-Bandingilo inscription. Governor Dollar promoted the reintegration of IDPs and returnees, and the U.S. Embassy commemorated staff who died supporting South Sudanese people. Two battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

President Kiir omorganiserte styret i South Sudan Revenue Authority, og gjeninnsatte to kommisjonærer etter å ha kansellert en tidligere ordre, mens advokatforeningen lanserte en veikart for å forbedre rettstilgangen. Regjeringen inngikk partnerskap med Israels Gilat for å tilby landsdekkende satellittinternett og sikret en UNESCO-verdensarvnominasjon for Boma-Bandingilo-innskrivingen. Guvernør Dollar fremmet reintegrering av internt fordrevne og returnerte, og den amerikanske ambassaden minnet om ansatte som døde mens de støttet det sørsudanske folket. To dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

The UN mission in Somalia has concluded while the UN food programme appointed a new head amid the renewed conflict. 2,824 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

FN-misjonen i Somalia er avsluttet mens FN-matprogrammet har utnevnt en ny leder midt i den fornyede konflikten. 2 824 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Somali army convoys continue to be ambushed by al-Shabaab, with recent heavy fighting near Baidoa and a stalled advance on Burhakabo, while al-Shabaab suffered significant losses in Operation Banooda and a Bay operation that reportedly killed 75 fighters. New to the situation, Fitgharan forces now control the Mogadishu-Baidoa corridor and Laftagareen forces have seized Buurhakaba and a town in Bay, extending combat in the south, and Ethiopia has withdrawn over 3,000 troops and will not intervene in the South West State conflict. The conflict has caused civilian displacement and flood risks, and 2,284 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

Ny i situasjonen er at Fitgharan-styrkene nå kontrollerer korridoren Mogadishu-Baidoa og Laftagareen-styrkene har erobret Buurhakaba og en by i Bay, og utvider kampene i sør, og Etiopia har trukket tilbake over 3 000 soldater og vil ikke gripe inn i konflikten i South West State. Konflikten har forårsaket sivilforskyvning og flomrisiko, og 2 284 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Gunmen have escalated attacks across northern Nigeria, killing Islamic scholar Sheikh Yahaya Masussuka in his home and killing multiple civilians in Plateau, including seven in one community and a 60‑year-old woman harvesting groundnuts. In eastern Nigeria, gunmen killed at least ten people, while in Taraba state a mass shooting in Binnari left 62 dead and dozens injured. Kidnappers abducted six residents in Kaduna and three vigilantes died in a separate Plateau incident. The conflict produced 1,486 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

I Øst-Nigeria drepte væpnede menn minst ti personer, mens en masseskyting i Binnari i Taraba-staten etterlot 62 døde og dusinvis sårede. Kidnapperne bortførte seks innbyggere i Kaduna, og tre voktere døde i en separat hendelse i Plateau. Konflikten førte til 1 486 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

Rebel forces captured weapons from fleeing DRC troops and Burundian troops, while DRC forces recaptured strategic territory from a rebel group led by an ex-president. Nigerian President Tinubu called for stronger African defence cooperation as the death toll from a separate attack in Taraba rose to 58. The conflict produced 1,158 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Opprørsstyrker tok våpen fra flyktende DRC-tropp og burundiske soldater, mens DRC-styrker gjenerobret strategisk territorium fra en opprørsgruppe ledet av en tidligere president. Nigerias president Tinubu oppfordret til sterkere afrikansk forsvarssamarbeid da dødstallet fra et separat angrep i Taraba steg til 58. Konflikten førte til 1 158 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.
